develop:0.en: Inside the signal lab, Grey Crow spread old maps across a cracked table. 'We need to *develop* a way to read the hidden code before Zero does,' he said. Ali traced the faint lines with her finger. Outside, rain hammered the glass. Time was running out.
develop:0.cnHint: 在信号实验室里，引路人要求我们____ 一种破解隐藏密码的方法。
develop:0.hook: Then the maps began to burn from the inside out.
develop:0.line: 'We need to *develop* a method, or this city falls silent forever.'

level:0.en: The basement server room hummed with cold light. Grey Crow checked the monitor and frowned. 'The interference has reached a *level* we have never seen before,' he said quietly. Ali looked at the numbers crawling up the screen. I felt the air grow heavy around us.
level:0.cnHint: 地下服务器室里，信号干扰的____已经超出了所有人的预期。
level:0.hook: The screen flashed once, then every number turned to zero.
level:0.line: 'This *level* of noise means someone is very close to us.'

enjoy:0.en: Ali poured two cups of hot tea and set one in front of me. 'Take a moment and *enjoy* it,' she said softly. 'We may not get another quiet minute tonight.' I held the warm cup. Through the thin wall, I could hear Zero's signal pulsing like a slow heartbeat.
enjoy:0.cnHint: 伙伴递来一杯热茶，让我____片刻的平静，因为今晚不会再有安宁了。
enjoy:0.hook: The pulse stopped — and the lights went dead.
enjoy:0.line: '*Enjoy* this warmth while you can; the cold is coming fast.'

fact:0.en: Grey Crow dropped a thick file on the table in front of me. 'Here is the *fact* you have been missing,' he said. 'Channel Seven was never shut down. It went underground.' The room felt smaller suddenly. Ali gripped my arm without a word.
fact:0.cnHint: 引路人揭示了一个关键____：第七频道从未真正关闭，而是转入了地下。
fact:0.hook: Somewhere below us, a transmitter clicked on.
fact:0.line: 'The *fact* is, Zero has been listening to us this whole time.'

news:0.en: The old radio on the shelf crackled to life at midnight. A voice read *news* in a flat, careful tone — but every third word was a code only we could hear. Ali wrote each one down fast. Grey Crow stood by the door, watching the street below.
news:0.cnHint: 午夜收音机突然播出一则____，其中每隔几个词就藏着只有我们听得懂的密码。
news:0.hook: The voice cut off mid-sentence and never came back.
news:0.line: 'That *news* broadcast just gave away our next meeting point.'

company:0.en: I did not want to enter the old switching station alone. Grey Crow nodded once. 'You will have *company*,' he said, and Ali stepped out of the shadows beside him. Together we crossed the wet floor toward the blinking console. Something moved at the far end of the room.
company:0.cnHint: 引路人告诉我进入旧交换站时会有____相伴，于是伙伴从暗处走了出来。
company:0.hook: The thing at the far end stepped closer, and it was not human.
company:0.line: 'Good — *company* means we last longer in the dark.'

cost:0.en: Grey Crow stared at the broken transmitter on the bench. 'Fixing this will *cost* us six hours,' he said. 'Six hours we do not have.' Ali began sorting parts anyway, her hands quick and steady. I watched the clock on the wall tick forward without mercy.
cost:0.cnHint: 引路人说修复发射器将____我们六个小时——而这六个小时，我们根本没有。
cost:0.hook: At that moment, Zero's voice came through the broken speaker, calm and clear.
cost:0.line: 'Every minute we wait will *cost* us more than you think.'

idea:0.en: Nobody spoke for a long time. The signal map was wrong and we all knew it. Then Ali looked up with bright eyes. 'I have an *idea*,' she said. 'We flip the frequency and let Zero find us first.' Grey Crow tilted his head slowly. I held my breath.
idea:0.cnHint: 就在大家一筹莫展之际，伙伴提出了一个大胆的____：主动暴露自己，引零现身。
idea:0.hook: Grey Crow smiled — and that was the most frightening thing I had seen all night.
idea:0.line: 'My *idea* is simple: we become the signal they are hunting.'

conversation:0.en: The server room smelled of hot circuits and old rain. Grey Crow leaned close and spoke in a low voice. 'This *conversation* is being recorded,' he said, 'by someone who is not in this room.' I checked the walls. Every panel had ears.
conversation:0.cnHint: 格雷·克罗提醒我，这场____正在被某个不在场的人秘密监听。
conversation:0.hook: The recorder's signal was coming from inside my own coat.
conversation:0.line: 'This *conversation* is already in the wrong hands.'

self:0.en: Ali pulled me into the backup server bay. The hologram flickered and showed a face — my face, but older, harder. 'That is your future *self*,' Ali whispered. 'It uploaded a warning three hours ago.' The warning was a single word: RUN.
self:0.cnHint: 全息影像里出现了我未来的____，它只留下了一个字的警告。
self:0.hook: The hologram then slowly turned and looked directly at me.
self:0.line: 'Your future *self* already knows what you will choose.'

age:0.en: The terminal deep in the archive room displayed files from another *age* — before the language bans, before Harbor City sealed its broadcasts. Grey Crow traced a line of old code with one finger. 'They buried the truth here,' he said, 'sixty years ago.'
age:0.cnHint: 档案室的终端里藏着来自另一个____的文件，六十年前的真相就埋在这里。
age:0.hook: One file carried today's date as its creation timestamp.
age:0.line: 'In this *age*, the truth is stored where no one looks.'

future:0.en: Zero stood at the far end of the relay room, back turned. 'You think you are saving the city,' Zero said coldly. 'But the *future* is already written in this signal.' A data stream lit up the floor between us like a river of white fire.
future:0.cnHint: 零点声称这座城市的____已经被这道信号提前写好了。
future:0.hook: The signal carried a timestamp three days from now.
future:0.line: 'The *future* you want to protect no longer exists.'

effect:0.en: Ali ran the decryption patch and we watched the screen in silence. The *effect* was immediate: hidden text bloomed across every monitor in the room, words the city had banned for thirty years. I felt the air change, as if the room itself had been holding its breath.
effect:0.cnHint: 解密补丁产生了立竿见影的____，三十年来被禁止的文字突然布满所有屏幕。
effect:0.hook: Among the banned words was my own name.
effect:0.line: 'The *effect* of this patch cannot be undone, not ever.'

local:0.en: Grey Crow spread a map across the table. 'Every *local* broadcast tower in the south grid has been quietly switched off,' he said. I counted seven dark nodes on the map. Someone was cutting Harbor City into pieces, one signal at a time.
local:0.cnHint: 城市南部所有____广播塔都已被悄悄关闭，有人正在一块一块地切断城市的联系。
local:0.hook: The eighth tower had gone dark while we were still talking.
local:0.line: 'Every *local* tower that goes dark is a word they erase.'

tend:0.en: 'Rookie investigators *tend* to trust the first voice they hear in a crisis,' Grey Crow said, not looking up from his screen. 'That is exactly what Zero is counting on.' I thought of the message I had already answered. My hand went cold.
tend:0.cnHint: 格雷·克罗提醒我，新手____于相信危机中听到的第一个声音，而零点正是利用了这一点。
tend:0.hook: The first voice I had trusted tonight belonged to Zero.
tend:0.line: 'You *tend* to follow the signal that speaks first — so does Zero.'

term:0.en: The contract on the screen was written in plain language, but one *term* stopped me cold: 'The bearer surrenders all rights to personal broadcast identity in perpetuity.' Ali read it over my shoulder and let out a slow breath. 'They want your voice,' she said. 'Forever.'
term:0.cnHint: 合同中有一项____让我当场僵住——它要求永久放弃个人广播身份的所有权利。
term:0.hook: Grey Crow's signature was already at the bottom of the page.
term:0.line: 'Read every *term* — one sentence in there owns you completely.'

suggest:0.en: The walls of Channel Seven's relay room were covered in coded graffiti. Grey Crow pointed at a spiral symbol near the broken screen. 'That mark didn't get there by chance,' he said quietly. The pattern seemed to *suggest* a hidden door, one that no map of this building had ever shown.
suggest:0.cnHint: 灰鸦指着墙上的螺旋符号，____那里藏着一扇秘密的门。
suggest:0.hook: Behind the door, something was still breathing.
suggest:0.line: 'These symbols *suggest* the exit is below us, not above.'

improve:0.en: Ali worked fast at the cracked terminal inside the relay room. 'Signal quality is at twelve percent,' she muttered. I watched the numbers climb as her fingers moved. She had found a way to *improve* the feed without triggering the city's auto-filters. Then, without warning, the screen went black.
improve:0.cnHint: 阿里设法____了信号质量，屏幕却突然熄灭了。
improve:0.hook: Someone else had just cut the line from inside.
improve:0.line: 'We need to *improve* the signal before Zero finds this room.'

affect:0.en: The encrypted broadcast from Channel Seven had been running for six days. Grey Crow spread his notes across the relay room floor. 'Exposure to this frequency can *affect* short-term memory,' he warned, tapping the page hard. I touched my temple. I could no longer recall how I had entered the building.
affect:0.cnHint: 灰鸦警告说，这个频率会____短期记忆，而我已经感受到了。
affect:0.hook: I could not remember a single step I had taken.
affect:0.line: 'Long exposure will *affect* your mind — put the headset down now.'

support:0.en: The relay room had one weak lamp and walls that dripped cold water. Ali passed me a folded sheet of data. 'Grey Crow sent this,' she said. 'It's *support* for our theory — proof that Zero has been inside Channel Seven for months.' I read the first line and felt the floor tilt.
support:0.cnHint: 阿里带来了灰鸦的资料，为我们的推断提供了____。
support:0.hook: The proof named someone I had trusted completely.
support:0.line: 'This data is *support* enough — we take it to the council tonight.'

hand:0.en: Zero stood at the far end of the relay room, back turned, studying a wall of static screens. I did not move. Then a small note slid across the floor toward my boot. I looked down. Ali's writing. It read: 'I need a *hand* — the east lock is jammed. Hurry.' Zero began to turn.
hand:0.cnHint: 阿里传来纸条，请求____，而对手正缓缓转身。
hand:0.hook: Zero's eyes found me before I could move.
hand:0.line: 'Give me a *hand* with this lock before he sees the light.'

finding:0.en: I had spent two hours sorting signal fragments in the cold relay room. When I lined them up on the table, the shape they formed stopped my breath. Grey Crow leaned in close. 'Document everything,' he said. This *finding* — a repeated code hidden inside static — could prove Channel Seven was never shut down.
finding:0.cnHint: 我把信号碎片排列成形，这一____证明第七频道从未真正关闭。
finding:0.hook: Someone had spent years making sure no one saw this.
finding:0.line: 'This *finding* changes every report we filed this year.'

ago:0.en: The relay room felt familiar in a wrong way. I checked the dust on the console — thick, but disturbed in one spot. Ali knelt beside me. 'Someone sat here,' she said. 'Not long *ago*, maybe two nights.' We both looked at the single cup still resting on the shelf, still warm.
ago:0.cnHint: 阿里发现有人在两夜____曾坐在这里，那只杯子还是温热的。
ago:0.hook: Warm ceramic meant our window was closing fast.
ago:0.line: 'Two nights *ago* someone ran this feed — and they left in a hurry.'

essay:0.en: On the relay room desk lay a single printed page. It looked, at first, like a student's *essay* — plain paragraphs, neat margins. But every seventh word, read aloud in order, formed a frequency key. Grey Crow had told me about this method once. Zero had learned it too.
essay:0.cnHint: 桌上那篇看似普通的____，其实每隔七个词就藏着一个频率密钥。
essay:0.hook: Zero had already decoded it — three hours before us.
essay:0.line: 'This *essay* is a cipher — read every seventh word aloud.'

reduce:0.en: Inside the signal room, Grey Crow pressed a cold key. 'Every broadcast leaves a trace,' he said. I watched him *reduce* the noise layer by layer until a single voice cut through — sharp, coded, and unmistakably Zero's. The room hummed. My hands would not stay still.
reduce:0.cnHint: 格雷·克劳在信号室里将干扰____，零点的声音从噪声中浮现。
reduce:0.hook: That voice should have been silent for three years.
reduce:0.line: 'We *reduce* the noise, and the truth finds us.'

process:0.en: Ali spread the data sheets across the floor of the relay station. 'It is a long *process*,' she said, tracing each line with one finger. Code strings looped back on themselves. I knelt beside her and saw it — a pattern no random machine could have made. Someone had planned this for months.
process:0.cnHint: 阿里在中继站解析数据的____中，发现了一个不寻常的规律。
process:0.hook: The pattern pointed to a name I had been told to forget.
process:0.line: 'The *process* is long, but the answer is already here.'

able:0.en: The jammer box sat in the corner, dark and quiet. I crossed every wire Grey Crow had drawn on the map. For one cold second I was not sure it would work. Then the screen blinked on. I was *able* to read the hidden channel at last — seven words, repeating, like a cry for help.
able:0.cnHint: 叙述者终于____读取隐藏频道，看到了七个不断重复的词。
able:0.hook: Seven words, and each one was my old call sign.

drive:0.en: Zero's message carried a single command: leave the city before dawn. I felt the cold *drive* of fear push me toward the door. Ali grabbed my arm. 'If you run, you confirm everything they suspect,' she said. Outside, rain hammered the roof. I stopped, hand on the latch, and breathed.
drive:0.cnHint: 零点的命令给叙述者带来了____，促使他想要逃跑。
drive:0.hook: Ali's grip tightened — she had heard the same command.
drive:0.line: 'Fear is a *drive*, but do not let it steer you.'

face:0.en: The monitor flickered and a still image loaded — grainy, half-lit, taken inside this very building. In the centre of the frame was a *face* I recognised at once: my own, younger, standing beside a man whose name had since been erased from every record. I could not look away.
face:0.cnHint: 监控画面中出现了一张____，让叙述者认出了一个被抹去的过去。
face:0.hook: The erased man was smiling straight at the camera.
face:0.line: 'That *face* in the frame — you know him, don't you.'

possible:0.en: Grey Crow circled the map twice. 'It is *possible* that the signal loops back through Sub-level Four,' he said, tapping the ink. Ali shook her head — Sub-level Four had been sealed after the flood. I looked at them both. Sealed did not mean empty. Someone had kept a key.
possible:0.cnHint: 格雷·克劳认为信号从四层回传是____的，但那层早已封闭。
possible:0.hook: The flood logs had been edited the same night it happened.
possible:0.line: 'It is *possible*. That is enough reason to go.'

similar:0.en: Ali laid two intercepts side by side under the lamp. The rhythm of the code was *similar* — same gap between pulses, same three-beat pause at the close. 'Two senders, or one sender on two nights,' she said quietly. The difference mattered more than I could explain to her right then.
similar:0.cnHint: 阿里发现两份截获信号的节奏____，怀疑来自同一个人。
similar:0.hook: One of those transmission nights, I had been the only one on duty.
similar:0.line: 'The pattern is *similar* — almost too similar to ignore.'

involve:0.en: Grey Crow set down his cup and looked at me straight. 'This case will *involve* people you trust,' he said. I waited. He named no one. The heater ticked. Ali was one floor above us, and I thought of every moment she had arrived early, stayed late, known things before I told her.
involve:0.cnHint: 格雷·克劳警告叙述者，此案会____他信任的人。
involve:0.hook: He was already looking at the ceiling when he said her name.
involve:0.line: 'Every big case will *involve* someone close to you.'

put:0.en: The server room hummed beneath Channel Seven's broadcast tower. I *put* the stolen data chip on the cold floor and knelt beside it. Grey Crow watched from the doorway, silent as a shadow. The chip held seven years of erased signals. One wrong move and every hidden voice would vanish forever.
put:0.cnHint: 我将偷来的数据芯片____在地上，灰鸦在门口默默注视。
put:0.hook: A red light blinked once — someone else was in the building.
put:0.line: '*Put* it down slowly, and don't let it touch the panel,' Grey Crow said.

difference:0.en: Ali spread two signal maps across the desk under a pale lamp. The *difference* between them was a single dark channel — Channel Seven — missing from the newer map. I stared at the gap. Someone had cut it out on purpose. That missing channel was the only path to the source.
difference:0.cnHint: 两张信号地图之间的____揭示了第七频道被刻意抹去的痕迹。
difference:0.hook: Ali's finger trembled as it traced the empty space.
difference:0.line: 'The *difference* is small, but it means someone deleted the signal by hand,' Ali said.

lack:0.en: I reviewed the case file for the third time inside the dim archive room. The *lack* of any witness report was the loudest clue. No one had seen the broadcast cut. No one claimed to hear the final message. In a city where everyone listened, total silence meant total fear.
lack:0.cnHint: 档案室里，案件记录中证人陈述的____本身就是最响亮的线索。
lack:0.hook: Then I found a name — crossed out in red ink.
lack:0.line: 'A *lack* of witnesses in this city means people are too scared to speak,' I said.

case:0.en: Grey Crow handed me a sealed metal box. 'This *case* has been locked since the blackout,' he said quietly. Inside, according to the label, were the original Channel Seven recordings — unedited, unfiltered. I turned it over in my hands. The lock had a fresh scratch. Someone had already tried to open it.
case:0.cnHint: 灰鸦交给我一个密封的金属____，里面据说装着第七频道的原始录音。
case:0.hook: The scratch on the lock was still bright — made within the hour.
case:0.line: 'This *case* was sealed by order of the Signal Bureau,' Grey Crow said flatly.

sure:0.en: Zero stood at the far end of the corridor, face half-hidden by static light. I was not *sure* whether he was warning me or daring me. He held up a small drive, then closed his fist around it. The hum of the building changed pitch. Something was powering down — fast.
sure:0.cnHint: 在走廊尽头看见零点时，我并不____他究竟是在警告我还是在挑衅我。
sure:0.hook: The lights cut out before I could take a single step.
sure:0.line: 'Are you *sure* you want to open that channel tonight?' Zero asked softly.

enough:0.en: I had *enough* signal fragments to reconstruct half of the lost broadcast. Half was not enough to prove anything in court, but it was enough to know the truth myself. Ali worked the decoder with steady hands. The room smelled of old wire and rain. Outside, the city kept moving, indifferent.
enough:0.cnHint: 我收集到的信号碎片____重建半段失落的广播，但只有一半。
enough:0.hook: The half we were missing turned out to be the dangerous half.
enough:0.line: '*Enough* fragments and we can rebuild the whole message,' Ali said without looking up.

attention:0.en: I kept my *attention* fixed on the blinking monitor while Grey Crow paced behind me. Channel Seven's ghost signal appeared for exactly three seconds, then dissolved. That was the pattern — brief, deliberate, designed for someone who already knew what to look for. Grey Crow stopped pacing. He had seen it too.
attention:0.cnHint: 我将全部____集中在闪烁的监视器上，等待第七频道的幽灵信号出现。
attention:0.hook: 'It is not random,' Grey Crow said, and his voice had no warmth left.
attention:0.line: 'Pay *attention* — it only shows for three seconds,' Grey Crow said.

certain:0.en: Ali pulled me aside near the filing cabinet. She spoke low and fast. She was *certain* the signal did not originate from outside the city — it came from inside this very building, on a floor that did not appear on any map. I checked the elevator panel. There was no button for that floor.
certain:0.cnHint: 阿栗____地告诉我，那个信号来自这栋楼内一个地图上根本不存在的楼层。
certain:0.hook: But there was a keyhole where the button should have been.
certain:0.line: 'I am *certain* the source is somewhere above us,' Ali whispered.

enable:0.en: Grey Crow handed me a cracked data chip. 'This will *enable* you to tune into Channel Seven,' he said, voice flat. I slotted it in. Static. Then a signal cut through — cold, precise, like a needle. Someone on the other end was already listening.
enable:0.cnHint: 引路人给了我一块芯片，它将____我接入第七频道。
enable:0.hook: The voice on the line knew my name.
enable:0.line: 'This chip will *enable* you to hear what Zero hides.'

simple:0.en: The receiver on my desk looked *simple* — a grey box, two wires, a dial. Ali had built it in one night. But when I turned the dial to Channel Seven, the room filled with a sound that made my hands go cold. Nothing about this job was simple anymore.
simple:0.cnHint: 阿栗造的装置看起来____，却传来了令人不安的信号。
simple:0.hook: The sound was a voice counting down from ten.
simple:0.line: 'It looks *simple*, but it can crack any locked broadcast.'

several:0.en: I had intercepted *several* fragments from Channel Seven before Grey Crow found me in the server hall. Each fragment carried the same three-digit code. Alone, they meant nothing. Together, they formed a map — and the map pointed to a room two floors below where I was standing.
several:0.cnHint: 我已截获____段信号碎片，它们拼出了一张地图。
several:0.hook: The room on the map was supposed to be sealed.
several:0.line: 'I have heard *several* of these signals — they all lead here.'

struggle:0.en: Ali pressed her ear to the wall and shook her head. The *struggle* to decode Channel Seven had cost us three nights and one burned router. Now the signal was clear, but what it said made no sense — unless Zero had already changed the rules while we were still learning them.
struggle:0.cnHint: 解码第七频道的____耗尽了我们的时间，而零点已改变了规则。
struggle:0.hook: Zero's new rule was already running.
struggle:0.line: 'This *struggle* is not over — Zero just raised the stakes.'

decision:0.en: Grey Crow looked at the blinking screen and said nothing for a long moment. The *decision* to broadcast on Channel Seven was not his to make alone. But the window was closing fast. He turned to me, jaw tight. Whatever I said next would either open the door or seal it.
decision:0.cnHint: 是否在第七频道广播，这个____不是引路人一个人能做的。
decision:0.hook: I opened my mouth and hoped I was right.
decision:0.line: 'The *decision* is yours — speak now or the signal dies.'

kid:0.en: The file on my screen showed a photo: a small *kid*, maybe nine, sitting alone in a white room with a headset on. The tag below read 'Channel Seven — first receiver.' Ali leaned over my shoulder, breath caught. Grey Crow had never told us the signal had a beginning this young.
kid:0.cnHint: 档案里的____是第七频道最早的接收者，这让我们震惊。
kid:0.hook: The child in the photo was listed as missing.
kid:0.line: 'That *kid* heard Channel Seven before any of us did.'

ability:0.en: Zero's broadcast cut in without warning. The voice was calm: 'Your *ability* to trace this signal ends here.' I checked the lock on the door. Still closed. Ali looked at the router — the trace was still running. Zero was bluffing. Or we were already caught.
ability:0.cnHint: 零点声称我们____追踪信号到此为止，但我们不确定他是否在虚张声势。
ability:0.hook: Then the router blinked once and went dark.
ability:0.line: 'Your *ability* to find me proves nothing — I want you here.'

task:0.en: Grey Crow slid a folded card across the table. On it, one line: Channel Seven, 03:00, listen only. 'That is your *task*,' he said. 'Do not speak, do not respond, do not record.' I picked up the card. Simple enough. But Ali's face told me simple was the wrong word.
task:0.cnHint: 引路人交给我一个____：在特定时间只听第七频道，不做任何其他事。
task:0.hook: At 03:00, the channel broadcast my own voice.
task:0.line: 'Your *task* is to listen — what you hear will change everything.'

risk:0.en: The server room under the neon bar was cold and silent. I found the wire Grey Crow had described — thin, red, taped to the wall. To pull it meant cutting power to the whole block. Ali watched the door. 'You have to *risk* it,' she said. I reached out.
risk:0.cnHint: 在霓虹酒吧下方的服务器室里，我必须决定是否____这一切。
risk:0.hook: My fingers touched the wire, and the lights began to flicker.
risk:0.line: 'You have to *risk* it — there is no other way out.'

success:0.en: The decryption took four hours. When the final lock broke open, Ali let out a slow breath. The hidden channel was ours. Grey Crow had said *success* in this city was never clean — it always left a mark on you. Looking at the data scrolling past, I believed him.
success:0.cnHint: 破解加密频道后，我们终于迎来了____，但代价依然存在。
success:0.hook: Then the screen showed one extra file — one nobody had put there.
success:0.line: 'Grey Crow warned me: *success* here always costs something you value.'

group:0.en: Ali spread the map across the wet table. Seven dots. Seven safe houses. 'This *group* moves signals through each one in order,' she said, tracing the line with her finger. I counted the hours we had left. Grey Crow was already at dot three, waiting. We had to move now.
group:0.cnHint: 阿里展示了地图，解释了这个____转移信号的路线。
group:0.hook: Dot four had just gone dark on the tracker.
group:0.line: 'This *group* has been running the same route for six months.'

course:0.en: Grey Crow had drawn the *course* of the signal on a thin strip of paper — rooftop relay, underground cable, then straight into the old archive building on Fifth. It was a long path. Zero knew it too. The question was who would reach the archive door first.
course:0.cnHint: 引路人标出了信号的____，但对手也掌握了同样的信息。
course:0.hook: Outside, a black car turned slowly onto Fifth Street.
course:0.line: 'The *course* is set — Zero already knows every step of it.'

relationship:0.en: The file named me. Not my street name — my real one. I stared at the screen. Grey Crow looked away. 'Our *relationship* with Zero is older than you know,' he said quietly. The rain hit the window. Something he had never told me was sitting right there in plain text.
relationship:0.cnHint: 档案里的内容揭示了引路人与零点之间的____，让我震惊。
relationship:0.hook: Grey Crow closed the file before I could read the last line.
relationship:0.line: 'Our *relationship* with Zero goes back further than you think.'

form:0.en: The message looked like a standard *form* — fields for name, district, access code. But Ali pointed at the bottom row. The letters there spelled a warning in a pattern only we used. Someone inside the system was trying to reach us without being seen. Grey Crow leaned in close.
form:0.cnHint: 那份看似普通的____其实藏着一条秘密警告。
form:0.hook: The sender's address was Zero's own registered terminal.
form:0.line: 'This *form* is not what it looks like — read the bottom row.'

interest:0.en: Zero never acted without reason. Grey Crow had taught me that. 'Find the *interest*,' he always said — find what someone stands to gain, and you find the truth. So I traced the signal back. Every path led to the same archive, the same sealed floor, the same locked name.
interest:0.cnHint: 引路人教我追查____，这条线索将我引向了同一个封锁的名字。
interest:0.hook: The name on the sealed floor was mine.
interest:0.line: 'Find the *interest* — that is where the real answer hides.'

simply:0.en: I asked Grey Crow why he had chosen me. He was quiet for a long time. The fan in the corner turned slowly. 'You *simply* hear things others do not,' he said at last, eyes on the dark window. It was not a compliment. It was a warning dressed as one.
simply:0.cnHint: 引路人____地说出了他选择我的原因，而那句话听起来更像警告。
simply:0.hook: Then his radio hissed, and every light in the room died.
simply:0.line: 'You *simply* hear what others cannot — that is why Zero wants you.'

survey:0.en: The back room of the radio shop smelled of burnt wire. I spread the city map across the counter and began to *survey* every block within two kilometres of the dead signal tower. Ali watched the door. Grey Crow tapped one district with a cold finger. 'That zone,' he said. 'Start there.'
survey:0.cnHint: 我在无线电店里____着信号塔附近的街区地图，灰乌鸦指向了某个区域。
survey:0.hook: The mark on the map was already circled — in fresh ink.
survey:0.line: '*Survey* the northern blocks first — Zero moves fast.'

care:0.en: Ali set the cracked data-chip on the table with slow hands. 'Handle it with *care*,' she said. 'One wrong touch and the file burns.' The room held its breath. Outside, rain drummed the sealed window. I reached for a pair of thin gloves and felt the weight of everything we might lose.
care:0.cnHint: 阿里提醒我要____地处理那枚破损的数据芯片，否则文件将永久损毁。
care:0.hook: Beneath the chip, a second chip lay hidden, paper-thin.
care:0.line: '*Care* matters here — that chip holds the only copy.'

state:0.en: Grey Crow pulled up the signal log on the old monitor. The numbers were wrong — too clean, too even. 'Look at the *state* of this feed,' he said quietly. 'Someone has been editing it for months.' The fan in the machine hummed. I wrote nothing down. Ink could be found.
state:0.cnHint: 灰乌鸦查看信号记录，发现数据的____明显经过人为篡改。
state:0.hook: The log showed one editor — and that editor was me.
state:0.line: 'The *state* of this feed tells me someone is watching.'

impact:0.en: The broadcast hit every receiver in the building at once. Ali pressed her hands over her ears. I felt the low boom in my chest — not sound, but something deeper. Grey Crow stayed still. 'Measure the *impact*,' he said. 'Which floors lost signal? Which ones did not?' That gap was the answer.
impact:0.cnHint: 一次强力广播突然覆盖整栋楼，灰乌鸦要我评估它的____范围。
impact:0.hook: Floor seven never lost signal — floor seven had been waiting.
impact:0.line: 'The *impact* on the lower floors was planned — count them.'

reason:0.en: Zero had left a message inside the locker, three lines of plain text. I read it twice. There was no threat, no demand — only a single *reason* for everything he had done. Ali leaned in. Her breath was sharp. Grey Crow said nothing, but his jaw tightened. I folded the paper.
reason:0.cnHint: 零点在储物柜里留下了一条信息，说明了他行动的____。
reason:0.hook: The reason named someone we trusted — it named Ali.
reason:0.line: 'Give me one *reason* not to walk out that door right now.'

close:0.en: The server room was smaller than I expected. The hum of machines was constant, almost warm. Ali stood *close* to the main terminal, shoulders touching mine, her eyes on the blinking cursor. 'We have forty seconds,' Grey Crow said from the doorway. I started to type. The cursor blinked faster.
close:0.cnHint: 阿里紧____着我站在主终端旁，我们只有四十秒完成操作。
close:0.hook: At thirty seconds, the door behind Grey Crow swung open.
close:0.line: 'Stay *close* — if we split up in here, we lose everything.'

individual:0.en: The wall was covered in profiles — names, frequencies, call signs. Grey Crow crossed his arms. 'Every *individual* on this board has sent the same coded phrase in the past week,' he said. I counted the faces: eleven. Ali found a twelfth, half-hidden behind a torn edge. None of them knew the others.
individual:0.cnHint: 告示板上每一个____都在同一周内发送过相同的加密短语。
individual:0.hook: The twelfth face on the board was mine.
individual:0.line: 'Each *individual* here was chosen — not by us, by Zero.'

area:0.en: The signal was strongest in the archive room, third floor, east wing. I moved through the stacks slowly, listening. Grey Crow had marked the *area* on my wrist map in red: six shelves, two exits, no cameras. Ali waited below. The shelves were old wood, dry and quiet. Then one creaked behind me.
area:0.cnHint: 灰乌鸦在我的手腕地图上标出了信号最强的____，我独自进入搜查。
area:0.hook: The creak came again — closer, and deliberate.
area:0.line: 'Clear the *area* fast — Zero knows this floor better than we do.'

popular:0.en: The signal came through Channel Seven — a *popular* pirate broadcast that half the city tuned in to, though the authorities denied its existence. I found the source in a back-room server den beneath a noodle shop. Grey Crow was already there, coat dripping, eyes sharp.
popular:0.cnHint: 我追踪到一个____的非法广播信号，在一家面馆地下找到了信号源。
popular:0.hook: Grey Crow's hand moved to silence me before I spoke.
popular:0.line: 'This *popular* signal is bait — someone wants us here.'

current:0.en: Inside the den, a wall of screens showed *current* city data: traffic, power lines, police routes — all live. Someone had been watching the whole grid for weeks. Ali knelt by the main console, fingers moving fast, face pale under the blue light.
current:0.cnHint: 地下室的屏幕显示着____的城市数据，有人一直在监控整个电网。
current:0.hook: Then every screen went dark at the same second.
current:0.line: 'The *current* data stops here — someone cut the feed six minutes ago.'

difficult:0.en: The encrypted log was *difficult* to crack — layer after layer of shifting code that rewrote itself each time I got close. Grey Crow watched over my shoulder without a word. Somewhere above us, boots crossed the floor of the noodle shop.
difficult:0.cnHint: 那段加密日志非常____，每次我快要破解时它就自动重写。
difficult:0.hook: The footsteps stopped — directly above my head.
difficult:0.line: 'It is *difficult*, but the last line always holds the real message.'

amount:0.en: Ali pulled up a ledger hidden inside the broadcast file. The *amount* listed was staggering — enough credits to buy silence from half the city council. I stared at the number and felt the case shift under my feet like loose ground.
amount:0.cnHint: 阿栗找到一份隐藏账本，上面记录的____大得足以收买半个市议会。
amount:0.hook: Someone had already signed the last page — using my name.
amount:0.line: 'That *amount* does not come from street money — this goes very high.'

point:0.en: Grey Crow tapped the screen and made his *point* in four words: the broadcast was a trap. Every signal, every data trail, every hidden ledger led back to one address — this room. We had walked in thinking we were hunters.
point:0.cnHint: 灰鸦用四个字说明了____：这个广播就是个陷阱。
point:0.hook: The door lock clicked from the outside.
point:0.line: 'The *point* is simple — we are the ones being watched.'

role:0.en: Zero's voice came through the speakers, calm and close, as if standing beside us. He said my *role* in this story had already been written — the fall guy, the rookie who found the evidence and then vanished. Ali grabbed my arm.
role:0.cnHint: 零点通过扬声器宣布我在这个阴谋中的____早已被安排好了。
role:0.hook: Ali whispered, 'There is a second door — move now.'
role:0.line: 'Your *role* was decided before you ever found that signal.'

develop:1.en: Rain hammered the street outside Channel Seven's old broadcast tower. Grey Crow handed me a cracked data chip. 'Someone used this to *develop* a new signal code,' he said, scanning the dark alley. 'It rewrites language in real time.' Footsteps echoed behind us. Whoever built this thing was still close.
develop:1.cnHint: 灰鸦在广播塔外交给我一块芯片，说有人用它____了一种能实时改写语言的新信号代码。
develop:1.hook: The footsteps stopped — right behind my shoulder.
develop:1.line: 'They used this chip to *develop* a code that can silence any voice in the city.'

level:1.en: Ali pulled me beneath a flickering neon sign. On the wall, coded graffiti covered three floors of brick. 'Each row is a different *level* of encryption,' she whispered, tracing the lines with her finger. The lowest row was fresh — painted tonight. Someone was still sending messages, right here on this street.
level:1.cnHint: 阿栗指着墙上的涂鸦说，每一行代表不同____的加密信息，而最底层是今晚刚写上去的。
level:1.hook: The wet paint smeared across Ali's fingertip — still warm.
level:1.line: 'The bottom *level* is the one that can get us killed.'

enjoy:1.en: Zero leaned against a food cart, eating noodles like the whole street wasn't being watched. I had always heard that top signal hackers *enjoy* the danger — they feed on it. He looked up, caught my eye, and smiled. It was the smile of someone who already knew every move I was going to make.
enjoy:1.cnHint: 零点悠闲地站在街边吃面，据说顶级信号黑客都____这种危险感，而他的笑容证明了这一点。
enjoy:1.hook: He knew my name before I said a single word.
enjoy:1.line: 'I *enjoy* being watched — it means they still fear me.'

fact:1.en: The rain washed old posters off the wall near the east gate. One poster hid a short printed line beneath it. Grey Crow read it aloud, voice flat: 'This is the *fact* they are trying to bury — Channel Seven never went off air.' I stared at the words. The official record said it shut down ten years ago.
fact:1.cnHint: 在东门的旧墙上，灰鸦发现了一行字，揭示了一个被掩盖的____：第七频道从未真正停播。
fact:1.hook: If the channel never stopped, someone has been broadcasting all along.
fact:1.line: 'The *fact* is, everything the city told you about Channel Seven is a lie.'

news:1.en: A small crowd gathered around a broken screen mounted on a corner wall. Static burst, then a voice cut through: 'This is the only real *news* left in Harbor City.' The words burned on-screen for three seconds and vanished. Ali grabbed my sleeve. Around the corner, two signal officers were already running toward us.
news:1.cnHint: 街角的破旧屏幕突然播出一段声音，自称是这座城市仅存的真实____，随即引来了信号警察。
news:1.hook: The screen cracked — and the voice kept broadcasting anyway.
news:1.line: 'That *news* just put every one of us on their list.'

company:1.en: I walked the night market alone — or so I thought. Grey Crow appeared at my side between two stalls, silent as smoke. 'You should not refuse *company* in this district,' he said, nodding toward a man tailing me three steps back. I had not noticed him once. Grey Crow had been watching me the whole time.
company:1.cnHint: 我以为自己独行于夜市，灰鸦却悄然出现提醒我不该拒绝____，因为背后已有人盯梢。
company:1.hook: The man tailing me was wearing a Channel Seven badge.
company:1.line: 'In this city, the wrong *company* can end your story fast.'

cost:1.en: Ali spread a hand-drawn map on a wet crate outside the old port gate. 'Breaking into the relay tower is possible,' she said, 'but the *cost* is high — we lose our cover the moment we move.' I traced the route with one finger. Every path had a trap. Someone had designed this maze knowing we would come.
cost:1.cnHint: 阿栗在港口城门外摊开地图分析，说闯入中继塔是可行的，但____极高，行动一旦开始就会暴露身份。
cost:1.hook: There was a fourth path on the map — drawn in someone else's hand.
cost:1.line: 'Whatever the *cost*, we have to reach that tower before dawn.'

idea:1.en: The signal scrambler buzzed in my coat pocket as I crossed the open square. Grey Crow's voice crackled through: 'I have an *idea* — the graffiti on the south pillar is not random art. It is a live frequency map.' I stopped in the middle of the square, exposed under cold floodlights, and looked south. The pillar was surrounded.
idea:1.cnHint: 我穿过广场时，灰鸦突然传来一个____：南侧柱子上的涂鸦其实是一张实时频率地图。
idea:1.hook: The figures around the pillar turned — all at once — toward me.
idea:1.line: 'My *idea* could unlock the whole network, but we have seconds to act.'

suggest:1.en: The coded graffiti covered the bridge wall for three blocks. Grey Crow traced each symbol with a gloved finger. 'These marks *suggest* a drop point,' he said quietly. I scanned the pattern. Somewhere in this wet city, Zero was already moving.
suggest:1.cnHint: 灰鸦在桥边的涂鸦中____出一个秘密交接地点。
suggest:1.hook: The mark on the last brick was still wet.
suggest:1.line: 'These marks *suggest* a drop point somewhere close.'

improve:1.en: The signal from Channel Seven was broken and weak. Ali adjusted the antenna on the rooftop dish three times. 'Every small fix will *improve* the reception,' she said. Rain hit the metal hard. Below us, a black car slowed down and stopped.
improve:1.cnHint: 阿里在屋顶努力____信号接收质量。
improve:1.hook: The black car's door swung open slowly.
improve:1.line: 'Each small change will *improve* the signal, trust me.'

affect:1.en: Zero had scattered noise bursts across the whole district. Every screen on the street flickered. Grey Crow grabbed my arm. 'The interference will *affect* our tracker within minutes,' he warned. I looked at the device in my hand. The numbers were already fading.
affect:1.cnHint: 零点散布的干扰信号开始____我们的追踪设备。
affect:1.hook: The last number on the tracker blinked and died.
affect:1.line: 'This noise will *affect* our tracker — move now.'

support:1.en: A crowd had gathered near the old market gate. Someone was broadcasting forbidden words from a speaker hidden in the arch. Ali pushed through to my side. 'We have no *support* out here,' she said flat and low. The crowd grew. The voice kept speaking.
support:1.cnHint: 在旧市场门口，阿里提醒我们没有任何____。
support:1.hook: Then the speaker went silent — and the crowd turned.
support:1.line: 'We have no *support* out here, just the two of us.'

hand:1.en: Grey Crow met me at the foot of the neon tower. He said nothing. He only reached out and pressed a folded card into my *hand*. I opened it under the rain. One word was printed inside. It was my own name, in Zero's handwriting.
hand:1.cnHint: 灰鸦把一张写有我名字的卡片塞进我的____里。
hand:1.hook: The handwriting matched no one I had ever met.
hand:1.line: 'Take it — someone left this in your *hand*.'

finding:1.en: I spread the printouts on the wet bench near the canal. Each page was a *finding* from last night's scan: hidden channels, ghost signals, two names I did not recognise. Ali leaned over my shoulder and pointed at the second name. She said nothing. She did not need to.
finding:1.cnHint: 我把运河边扫描到的每一条____摊开仔细查看。
finding:1.hook: The second name belonged to someone inside our own team.
finding:1.line: 'Every *finding* here points to the same signal source.'

ago:1.en: Grey Crow stopped at the old phone box on Tide Street. 'Zero used this box two hours *ago*,' he said. The glass was cracked. Inside, a strip of tape on the receiver held three numbers written in red. I photographed it fast. Behind me, footsteps.
ago:1.cnHint: 灰鸦说零点就在两个小时____用过这部电话。
ago:1.hook: The footsteps stopped right outside the box.
ago:1.line: 'Zero was standing here two hours *ago* — smell the rain.'

essay:1.en: The wall near the east gate was covered in printed text. At first it looked like a political *essay*, the kind posted by students. But Grey Crow read it line by line and went pale. 'This is a map,' he said. 'Every third word is a coordinate.'
essay:1.cnHint: 东门墙上贴着一篇看似普通的____，实则藏着地图坐标。
essay:1.hook: The last coordinate pointed directly to our safe house.
essay:1.line: 'This *essay* is not what it looks like — read it again.'

reduce:1.en: The rain hammered the street outside Channel Seven's back alley. Grey Crow crouched by a humming relay box, fingers moving fast. 'If we *reduce* the signal noise by half,' he said, 'the hidden broadcast becomes readable.' Somewhere above, a shutter banged. Someone had heard us.
reduce:1.cnHint: 灰鸦试图____信号干扰，让隐藏的广播变得可读。
reduce:1.hook: The shutter banged again — closer this time.
reduce:1.line: 'We need to *reduce* the noise before Zero locks on to us.'

process:1.en: Ali pulled me into a doorway as a patrol drone swept the neon-lit block. 'The *process* takes three minutes,' she whispered, tapping the cracked screen of her decoder. 'First the scan, then the filter, then the key.' Three minutes felt like a lifetime on a street this exposed.
process:1.cnHint: 阿栗向我解释解码的____，而无人机就在头顶巡逻。
process:1.hook: The drone doubled back, its red eye sweeping lower.
process:1.line: 'Trust the *process* — every step counts or we lose the signal.'

able:1.en: Zero's jamming grid covered six blocks. I ran three of them before my legs burned. At the corner of Tide Street I finally spotted the relay tower Grey Crow had marked on my map. I was *able* to reach it only because the rain had knocked out the nearest camera cluster.
able:1.cnHint: 我终于____到达中继塔，因为雨水恰好击毁了附近的摄像头。
able:1.hook: A light inside the tower flickered — someone was already in there.
able:1.line: 'I am *able* to get us in, but only if you cover the east door.'

drive:1.en: Ali said hunger was not what kept us moving through Harbor City's flooded back streets. It was something colder: the *drive* to crack the code before Zero broadcast it city-wide and locked every honest voice out forever. We splashed on through the dark, saying nothing.
drive:1.cnHint: 是一种强烈的内在____让我们在暴雨中继续前行。
drive:1.hook: Ahead, the street ended — and Zero's van was parked right there.
drive:1.line: 'That *drive* in your eyes — do not let Zero see it or he will use it.'

face:1.en: The coded graffiti covered the entire *face* of the bridge wall, symbol after symbol climbing toward the cables. Grey Crow ran his light across it slowly. 'This is a map,' he said quietly. Every tag we had chased for a week pointed here, to this bridge, to this moment.
face:1.cnHint: 桥墙的____上布满了密码涂鸦，灰鸦认出那是一张地图。
face:1.hook: One symbol at the top was still wet — painted within the hour.
face:1.line: 'Look at the *face* of the wall — the newest tag is a warning.'

possible:1.en: Grey Crow said it was *possible* that Zero had already moved the transmitter. Ali disagreed, pointing at the fresh scorch mark on the pavement — power cables, pulled in a hurry. Someone had been here minutes ago. The rain was erasing the evidence fast. We had one chance.
possible:1.cnHint: 灰鸦认为发射器已被转移是____的，但地面的焦痕说明时机未过。
possible:1.hook: Ali grabbed my arm: the scorch mark was still warm.
possible:1.line: 'It is still *possible* to trace him — that burn is less than ten minutes old.'

similar:1.en: Ali held the two intercepted tokens side by side under the orange streetlight. The patterns were *similar* — same rhythm, same gap length — but the second one carried an extra pulse buried in the noise. 'They are not copies,' she said. 'One is the lock. One is the trigger.'
similar:1.cnHint: 两段截获的信号____，但阿栗发现其中一个藏着额外的脉冲。
similar:1.hook: If we used the wrong one, every screen in Harbor City would go dark.
similar:1.line: 'The rhythm is *similar*, yes, but that hidden pulse changes everything.'

involve:1.en: Grey Crow caught my wrist before I touched the relay box. 'This will *involve* every node on the grid,' he said. 'You trip one, you wake them all.' Above us the city hummed, ten thousand signal threads stitched through the rain. One wrong move and we were the signal.
involve:1.cnHint: 灰鸦警告我，这个操作会____整个信号网络的每一个节点。
involve:1.hook: My finger was still half a centimetre from the switch.
involve:1.line: 'Do not touch that — it will *involve* the whole grid and expose us instantly.'

conversation:1.en: Rain hammered the cracked street outside Channel Seven's relay tower. I pressed my back against a cold wall and listened. Grey Crow stood two metres away, speaking in a low voice. The *conversation* he was having with Zero was not meant for my ears — but I heard every word through my signal implant.
conversation:1.cnHint: 我用信号植入体偷听了一场不该听到的____。
conversation:1.hook: Zero's last sentence was a name — my name.
conversation:1.line: 'That *conversation* ends now,' Zero said, turning his eyes toward the shadows.

self:1.en: The stolen identity chip burned in my coat pocket as I crossed the night market under Channel Seven's broadcast tower. Grey Crow had warned me: in Harbor City, your *self* is just data, and data can be copied, sold, or erased. I checked my reflection in a dark shopfront window and was not sure who looked back.
self:1.cnHint: 在这座城市，连一个人的____都可以被复制出售。
self:1.hook: The reflection blinked — one second before I did.
self:1.line: 'Your *self* is the only thing Zero cannot fake,' Grey Crow said quietly.

age:1.en: The eastern underpass was covered in coded graffiti dating back decades. Ali ran her finger along one painted line and said this *age* of encrypted streets had begun the night the city council banned open speech. I stared at the oldest tag on the wall — and recognised the handwriting as my own.
age:1.cnHint: 阿栗说，这个____始于那个言论被封锁的夜晚。
age:1.hook: My handwriting — yet I had never been here before.
age:1.line: 'Every *age* leaves its mark on the walls,' Ali said softly.

future:1.en: Grey Crow spread a stolen transit map across a rain-wet crate near the harbour gate. He circled three intersections in red and told me the *future* of Channel Seven's signal depended on which route we chose tonight. One road led to the relay core; the other two led to traps Zero had already set.
future:1.cnHint: 七频道信号的____取决于我们今晚选择哪条路线。
future:1.hook: Grey Crow's hand was trembling over the red circles.
future:1.line: 'The *future* is one road wide tonight,' Grey Crow said.

effect:1.en: Zero's jamming pulse hit the street-level speakers outside the transit hall just as Ali and I reached the corner. The *effect* was instant: every screen in the block went dark and the crowd froze in sudden silence. In that silence I heard a single clean frequency cutting through — a voice that sounded exactly like mine.
effect:1.cnHint: 零点的干扰脉冲产生了立竿见影的____，整条街陷入黑暗。
effect:1.hook: The voice on that frequency was reading my private case notes.
effect:1.line: 'The *effect* is already spreading,' Ali said, gripping my arm.

local:1.en: I ducked into a narrow lane behind the *local* night-market radio stall, the one that still broadcast on copper wire instead of encrypted beam. The vendor, an old man with a scarred ear, slid a folded note across the counter without looking at me. Outside, Zero's patrol drone swept its light across the lane entrance.
local:1.cnHint: 我躲进一家____夜市摊位后面的小巷，收到了一张神秘纸条。
local:1.hook: The note had only four words: 'They have Grey Crow.'
local:1.line: 'Every *local* vendor here reports to someone,' the old man whispered.

tend:1.en: Patrol drones *tend* to follow the main boulevard lights, so Grey Crow always moved through the side alleys after midnight. I had learned that rule in my first week. Tonight, though, every alley near Channel Seven's outer wall was lit like midday, and two of Grey Crow's usual shadows were gone from their posts.
tend:1.cnHint: 巡逻无人机____沿主干道飞行，但今晚规律被打破了。
tend:1.hook: Something had cleared those alleys — and it was not the city guard.
tend:1.line: 'Drones *tend* to miss what moves below their light,' Ali noted.

term:1.en: The broadcast contract Grey Crow had signed with Channel Seven used one buried *term* that Zero had apparently found: any operator who missed three scheduled signals in a row became city property. Grey Crow had missed two already. I stood at the corner of the relay street and started counting the minutes to the next broadcast window.
term:1.cnHint: 合同里有一个隐藏的____，零点似乎已经发现了它。
term:1.hook: The clock on the relay tower showed four minutes left.
term:1.line: 'There is one *term* in that contract that will end us,' Grey Crow said.

risk:1.en: Rain hammered the cracked street outside Channel Seven's old relay tower. Grey Crow pulled me close and whispered fast. 'Zero has eyes on the east wall.' I checked the open ground between us and the door. To cross it was to *risk* everything — one step into the light and we were finished.
risk:1.cnHint: 灰鸦警告我，穿过那片空地就是在____生命。
risk:1.hook: The floodlight swept the alley — one second left.
risk:1.line: 'You *risk* your cover the moment you step out there.'

success:1.en: We reached the relay tower's side entrance without a sound. Ali gave a short nod. Getting this far had felt impossible an hour ago — three checkpoints, a jammed signal, and Zero's patrol drones overhead. Yet here we stood, breathless in the wet dark. This small *success* meant the next move was now real.
success:1.cnHint: 尽管困难重重，我们悄悄到达了目标地点，迎来了第一个____。
success:1.hook: A drone hummed back — it had turned around.
success:1.line: 'One *success* means nothing if Zero already changed the code.'

group:1.en: The coded graffiti covered the east wall of the underpass in layers. Ali traced a symbol with one finger. 'This mark belongs to a *group* that went silent six months ago,' she said quietly. Rainwater ran down the lines of paint like cold ink. Someone had added a fresh tag on top — tonight.
group:1.cnHint: 阿里发现涂鸦暗示某个____已经重新现身。
group:1.hook: The fresh paint was still wet under my thumb.
group:1.line: 'That *group* does not leave marks unless they want to be found.'

course:1.en: Grey Crow spread a thin paper map against the damp wall. He traced three lines with his finger — each one a possible *course* through the port district to Zero's signal tower. Two routes crossed open ground. One ran under the old fish market, dark and narrow. He tapped that line twice and said nothing.
course:1.cnHint: 灰鸦在地图上为我们规划穿越港区的____。
course:1.hook: The path he chose had been closed for ten years.
course:1.line: 'This *course* keeps us off every camera between here and the tower.'

relationship:1.en: I had known Ali for three weeks, but standing in the rain outside the relay tower felt like much longer. She passed me a dry battery pack without being asked. Grey Crow watched us and almost smiled. In Harbor City trust was rare — whatever this *relationship* was, it had already kept us both alive twice.
relationship:1.cnHint: 在这座危险的城市里，我们之间的____已经悄然改变。
relationship:1.hook: Then Ali's hand froze on my arm — she heard something.
relationship:1.line: 'Our *relationship* means I tell you the truth: this path is watched.'

form:1.en: The signal arrived not as sound but as light — a slow pulse on the cracked screen bolted above the night market stall. Ali grabbed my sleeve. 'Read the *form* of the blink,' she said. 'Long, short, short — that is Grey Crow's sign.' The market crowd moved around us, seeing nothing. We saw everything.
form:1.cnHint: 信号以一种特殊的____出现在市场上方的屏幕上。
form:1.hook: The next pulse never came — the screen went black.
form:1.line: 'The *form* of that signal matches the one he used last year.'

interest:1.en: Zero had left a data chip on the bench at the open-air tram stop — in plain view, wrapped in a yellow band. Grey Crow said not to touch it. I could not look away. 'Your *interest* is showing,' he said flatly. 'Zero counts on that.' I put my hands in my pockets and stared at the rails instead.
interest:1.cnHint: 我对那枚芯片表现出的____正中对手的圈套。
interest:1.hook: The tram was late — and Zero was somewhere close.
interest:1.line: 'Your *interest* in that chip is exactly what Zero wants to see.'

simply:1.en: I asked Grey Crow how Zero had bypassed the whole port security grid. He was quiet for a long moment, rain dripping from the brim of his hood. Then he turned and looked at me with flat, tired eyes. 'Zero did not break the system,' he said. 'Zero *simply* knew everyone who built it.'
simply:1.cnHint: 灰鸦告诉我，对手____是利用了内部关系，并非强行破解。
simply:1.hook: That meant someone we trusted was already on Zero's list.
simply:1.line: 'Zero *simply* walked in — because half the guards owed him a favor.'

put:1.en: Rain hit the pavement like static. I found Grey Crow crouched by a cracked wall, *putting* a small transmitter behind a loose brick. 'Channel seven opens in three minutes,' he said without looking up. Around us, coded graffiti glowed faint blue under the neon wash. The street held its breath.
put:1.cnHint: 灰鸦在砖缝里____了一个发射器，倒计时已经开始。
put:1.hook: The wall began to hum before his hand pulled back.
put:1.line: '*Put* this where no scanner can reach it.'

difference:1.en: Ali stood at the crossroads, scanning two alleys. One led toward the signal tower; the other toward Zero's last known position. 'There is a *difference* between these routes,' she said, eyes tight. 'One brings you home.' The neon signs buzzed overhead, each flickering in its own broken rhythm. I had to choose fast.
difference:1.cnHint: 阿栗指出两条路之间的____，但没有说哪条更安全。
difference:1.hook: She was already gone before I asked which one she meant.
difference:1.line: 'The *difference* between those paths is your life.'

lack:1.en: The checkpoint guard waved me through without checking my badge. Grey Crow had warned me about this district — a *lack* of security here meant something worse was waiting deeper in. Puddles reflected red signs. My earpiece crackled with half a word, then went silent. I kept walking and counted my steps.
lack:1.cnHint: 这片区域____安全检查，灰鸦说那意味着更大的危险。
lack:1.hook: The silence at the far end of the street was total and wrong.
lack:1.line: 'A *lack* of guards never means you are safe.'

case:1.en: Ali pressed a damp folder into my hands under the overpass. 'This *case* has been open for eleven years,' she said. 'Nobody in the department wants to touch it.' Rain dripped from rusted beams above. The folder held three photographs and a single frequency number. My thumb hovered over the first photo.
case:1.cnHint: 阿栗交给我一个拖了十一年的____，里面只有三张照片。
case:1.hook: The face in the first photograph was one I already knew.
case:1.line: 'This *case* will not close itself — not this time.'

sure:1.en: I checked the corner twice before stepping out. Grey Crow had told me to be *sure* the lamp post with the yellow tape was clear before I moved. It was. But as my boot touched the open street, a shadow crossed the far end — too slow, too deliberate. Someone else was watching the same post.
sure:1.cnHint: 我确认路灯旁边没有人，____是安全的，然而阴影出现了。
sure:1.hook: The shadow stopped exactly where I had planned to stop.
sure:1.line: 'Are you *sure* you were not followed here tonight?'

enough:1.en: The broadcast cut out after four words. Four words were *enough* — I had the block, the channel, the time. Ali was already typing the decode on her sleeve-pad across the street. Zero must have known we were close; the signal lasted less than two seconds. Above us a drone circled, slow and patient.
enough:1.cnHint: 只有四个词的广播，但已经____让我锁定了目标频道。
enough:1.hook: The drone's light swept toward Ali before she could move.
enough:1.line: 'Four words are *enough* if you know how to listen.'

attention:1.en: Zero walked through the night market without hurrying, buying a skewer he never ate. It was a show — every move designed to pull *attention* toward himself and away from the side street where the real exchange was happening. I saw through it. I turned my back on Zero and watched the shadows instead.
attention:1.cnHint: 零点故意吸引所有人的____，好让真正的交易悄悄进行。
attention:1.hook: In the side street, a door closed with barely a sound.
attention:1.line: 'Keep your *attention* on the shadows, not the lights.'

certain:1.en: I leaned against the wet railing and studied the rooftop across the canal. Grey Crow said a *certain* antenna up there switched frequencies at midnight. It was eleven fifty-eight. The antenna looked dead. But dead things in Harbor City had a habit of waking at the worst possible moment. I raised my recorder.
certain:1.cnHint: 灰鸦说运河对面某个____天线会在午夜切换频道。
certain:1.hook: At midnight exactly, every light on the rooftop went out.
certain:1.line: 'A *certain* person placed that antenna — and it was not us.'

enable:1.en: Grey Crow handed me a small chip wrapped in black tape. 'Plug this into the signal post,' he said, voice flat. The chip would *enable* my scanner to read the coded graffiti on the walls — messages Zero had hidden in plain sight for weeks. Rain hit the pavement hard.
enable:1.cnHint: 灰鸦给了我一个芯片，声称它能____我的扫描仪读取墙上的密码涂鸦。
enable:1.hook: The signal post exploded with light before I touched it.
enable:1.line: 'This chip will *enable* you to hear what the walls are saying.'

simple:1.en: Ali crouched by the drain and traced the symbol with one finger. 'People walk past this every day,' she said. The mark looked *simple* — just three lines crossing — but my scanner screamed when it got close. Zero never made anything easy. Nothing here ever was.
simple:1.cnHint: 阿里指着排水沟旁那个看似____的符号，我的扫描仪却发出了警报。
simple:1.hook: Beneath the symbol, something ticked like a clock.
simple:1.line: 'It looks *simple*, but that is exactly why no one questions it.'

several:1.en: I had passed the corner of Neon Lane *several* times tonight, each time catching a different fragment of the broadcast — a number, a colour, a name. Grey Crow said the pieces would form a map. Ali was still counting. The rain had not stopped once in three hours.
several:1.cnHint: 我____次经过霓虹巷街角，每次都截获了广播中不同的碎片信息。
several:1.hook: On the fourth pass, someone was already waiting for me.
several:1.line: 'I have told you *several* times — do not stop moving on this street.'

struggle:1.en: The locked gate at the harbour end of Fifth Street would not move. My *struggle* with the old bolt drew looks from two figures under a broken lamp. I kept my head down and my scanner hidden. Ali had said the package was on the other side. I had to get through.
struggle:1.cnHint: 我在五街尽头与生锈的铁门____，引来了路灯下两个可疑人物的注意。
struggle:1.hook: One of the figures began walking toward me.
struggle:1.line: 'Every *struggle* you show them is a signal — hide it.'

decision:1.en: Grey Crow's voice crackled through my earpiece at the crossroads. Left led to Zero's last known drop point. Right led to the safe room where Ali was waiting. I had ten seconds. Every *decision* on this job had cost something. I looked left, then right, then left again.
decision:1.cnHint: 在十字路口，我必须做出一个____：向左追踪零点，还是向右找阿里。
decision:1.hook: My earpiece went dead exactly as I chose.
decision:1.line: 'This *decision* is yours alone — I cannot make it for you.'

kid:1.en: A small *kid* sat on an upturned crate at the edge of the market, drawing in a notebook. No child should be out at this hour in this part of the city. When I looked closer, the drawing was a perfect copy of the symbol Ali had flagged that morning.
kid:1.cnHint: 市场边缘有个____坐在那里写生，他画的竟然是阿里今晨标记的神秘符号。
kid:1.hook: The kid closed the notebook and looked straight at me.
kid:1.line: 'Even a *kid* can carry a message — that is the point.'

ability:1.en: Zero was known across Harbor City for one thing above all: the *ability* to vanish from a crowded street in under four seconds. I had studied the footage. I had timed it. Tonight, standing at the wet mouth of Market Alley, I was about to test whether I could do the same.
ability:1.cnHint: 零点以在人群中瞬间消失的____闻名，而今晚我要在这条小巷里验证自己是否也能做到。
ability:1.hook: Footsteps rounded the corner, and I had three seconds.
ability:1.line: 'Your *ability* to stay unseen is the only thing keeping you alive tonight.'

task:1.en: Grey Crow had kept the briefing short: reach the old signal tower before the broadcast ended, plant the trace device, leave no sign. A clear *task*, he had called it. Standing now in the flooded alley below the tower, water at my knees, I saw nothing clear about it.
task:1.cnHint: 灰鸦交给我一项____：在广播结束前到达旧信号塔并植入追踪装置，但现实远比命令复杂。
task:1.hook: The broadcast countdown read nine seconds — and counting.
task:1.line: 'Complete the *task* and ask questions after — not before.'

popular:1.en: Rain hit the street market hard. Vendors packed up fast. But one stall stayed open — a man selling signal scramblers. His cheap little devices were *popular* with anyone who wanted to vanish from the city grid. Grey Crow watched from the shadow of a broken lamp post and said nothing.
popular:1.cnHint: 街市上，一个摊位出售的设备在想要消失于城市网络的人中非常____。
popular:1.hook: Grey Crow's eyes locked on the last customer's face.
popular:1.line: 'These *popular* little boxes — someone powerful wants them gone.'

current:1.en: I stood at the edge of Channel Seven's broadcast tower, wind cutting my coat. The *current* security code changed every sixty seconds — Ali had told me that much. I had fifty seconds left. Below, Zero's team moved through the wet street like shadows hunting a signal.
current:1.cnHint: 广播塔边，我只有五十秒来破解____的安全密码。
current:1.hook: The counter hit zero before my fingers stopped moving.
current:1.line: 'The *current* code is live — you have one shot, use it.'

difficult:1.en: The coded graffiti covered the entire underpass wall. Ali crouched beside me, torch in hand. Reading the street cipher was *difficult* enough in daylight; in the rain and dark it felt close to impossible. Somewhere ahead, Zero had left a message — and I needed it before dawn.
difficult:1.cnHint: 在黑暗和雨中，破译地下通道墙上的暗语密码非常____。
difficult:1.hook: Then one symbol on the wall began to glow faint red.
difficult:1.line: 'It is *difficult*, yes — but the answer is already in front of you.'

amount:1.en: Grey Crow dropped a small card on the wet pavement between us. On it was a single number — a large *amount* of city credits, more than I would earn in two years. Payment for one job: find Zero before sunrise. I looked up. Grey Crow was already walking away.
amount:1.cnHint: 灰鸦留下一张卡片，上面写着一笔巨大的____作为报酬。
amount:1.hook: The card dissolved in the rain, leaving only the number burned in my mind.
amount:1.line: 'That *amount* is real — but only if you deliver by dawn.'

point:1.en: Zero had left a mark on the corner post — a small arrow, scratched deep into the metal. Ali grabbed my arm. 'That is the *point* everyone misses,' she said quietly, 'the arrow does not show where to go. It shows where not to go.' The street behind us had gone silent.
point:1.cnHint: 阿栗指出路标暗号的____：箭头指示的是禁区，而非方向。
point:1.hook: Something moved in the silence where the arrow was pointing.
point:1.line: 'The *point* is simple — trust the mark, not the map.'

role:1.en: I watched the street performer work the small crowd near the neon bridge. He looked harmless. Grey Crow had warned me otherwise. 'His *role* is not entertainment,' the message had said. 'He reads faces for Zero.' I pulled my hood low and kept walking, heart tight, steps slow and steady.
role:1.cnHint: 那个街头艺人的真实____并非表演，而是替零点监视人群。
role:1.hook: He stopped mid-act and turned his eyes straight toward me.
role:1.line: 'My *role* ends tonight — and yours is just beginning.'

survey:1.en: The rain had stopped, but the street was still wet. I moved through the crowd near Channel Seven's old broadcast tower, trying to *survey* the area for Zero's signal drops — small chalk marks on walls that only I could read. Grey Crow had taught me the pattern. Something was off tonight.
survey:1.cnHint: 叙述者在旧广播塔附近____周围环境，寻找零点留下的暗号。
survey:1.hook: One mark pointed down — toward the drain, where something blinked.
survey:1.line: '*Survey* every wall before you move,' Grey Crow said, eyes ahead.

care:1.en: Ali was waiting under the broken sign at Fifth and Neon, hood up, arms crossed. She looked calm, but I knew better. The *care* she took with every step — never the same path twice — told me she had already spotted a tail. Grey Crow had trained her well. So had fear.
care:1.cnHint: 阿栗用极度____的方式走路，暗示她已察觉有人跟踪。
care:1.hook: She turned once, sharply, and the tail was gone.
care:1.line: 'Take *care* — someone is counting your steps,' Ali said quietly.

state:1.en: The broadcast tower's old screen flickered to life above us. It showed nothing but static, yet Grey Crow stared at it hard. 'The *state* of that signal,' he said, almost to himself, 'is wrong.' He meant more than the screen. In Harbor City, broken signals meant broken safety.
state:1.cnHint: 灰鸦盯着塔上的屏幕，说信号的____不对劲。
state:1.hook: Then the static formed a single word: RUN.
state:1.line: 'The *state* of this signal tells me we are already too late.'

impact:1.en: Zero's drone dropped a small device from above. It hit the wet pavement with a sharp crack. The *impact* sent a pulse through every nearby screen — storefronts, traffic boards, even Ali's wrist display all blinked the same coded red. The message lasted one second. I caught only three words.
impact:1.cnHint: 零点的装置落地后，其____让附近所有屏幕同时闪出一条暗语。
impact:1.line: 'The *impact* woke every screen on the block,' Ali said, pale.

reason:1.en: I pulled Grey Crow behind a parked transport. 'Why would Zero expose the drop site now?' I asked. Grey Crow was quiet for a moment, watching the crowd thin out fast — too fast. 'The *reason*,' he said slowly, 'is that Zero wants us exactly here, exactly now.' My chest went cold.
reason:1.cnHint: 灰鸦说出零点暴露地点的____，让叙述者背脊发凉。
reason:1.hook: Above us, a second drone appeared, already descending.
reason:1.line: 'The *reason* is simple — this is a trap,' Grey Crow said flat.

close:1.en: The alley mouth was narrow. I pressed against the wall and listened. Footsteps — steady, unhurried. Whoever it was knew I was here. Ali's voice came through my earpiece, barely a whisper: 'Too *close*. Do not move.' The steps slowed. A shadow reached the edge of the light and stopped.
close:1.cnHint: 有人的脚步声越来越____，阿栗低声提醒叙述者不要动。
close:1.hook: The shadow stretched, touched my boot, and held still.
close:1.line: 'Too *close* — if you breathe loud, they will hear,' Ali warned.

individual:1.en: Grey Crow spread a worn map on the hood of a dead vehicle. Each red dot marked a separate listening post. 'Every *individual* post has gone silent in the last hour,' he said, tracing the dots with one finger. The silence formed a shape on the map. It was an arrow, pointing here.
individual:1.cnHint: 灰鸦指出每个____监听点都已沉默，它们连成了一个箭头。
individual:1.hook: The arrow's tip landed on the exact spot where we stood.
individual:1.line: 'Each *individual* post fell silent — that is not an accident,' he said.

area:1.en: The coded graffiti changed block by block. Near the old harbor gate, the tags shifted from blue to red — a warning system only runners knew. I scanned the *area* quickly: two exits, one blocked by a freight unit, the other lit too bright. Zero had planned this well. I had one move left.
area:1.cnHint: 叙述者迅速扫视这片____，发现零点已经把两条出路都堵死了。
area:1.hook: My one move meant trusting someone I had never trusted before.
area:1.line: 'This *area* is sealed — Zero thought of everything,' I said.

develop:2.en: Deep in the server room beneath Channel Seven, I found a cracked drive. Ali had hidden it here weeks ago. On it: a half-built program, lines of code designed to *develop* a signal that could break Zero's encryption wall. The program was unfinished. Someone had cut Ali off before she could complete it.
develop:2.cnHint: 阿里留下了一个半成品程序，正试图____出能突破零点加密墙的信号。
develop:2.hook: The last file was dated the night Ali disappeared.
develop:2.line: 'We have to *develop* this code before Zero finds the drive.'

level:2.en: The elevator stopped at sub-basement three — a *level* most staff did not know existed. The walls here were raw concrete, lit by a single red strip. Someone had been living down here. A cot, a cold cup of water, coded notes pinned in rows. The smell of burnt wire still hung in the air.
level:2.cnHint: 电梯停在一个鲜为人知的地下____，那里有人秘密居住过。
level:2.hook: One note read: 'They know where you sleep.'
level:2.line: 'This *level* is not on any map I have ever seen.'

enjoy:2.en: Grey Crow slid a small data chip across the table. 'Take it,' he said. 'You will not *enjoy* what is on it, but you need to know.' I plugged it in. The screen filled with footage of me — my every move for the past week, recorded without my knowledge, cut into a neat little file.
enjoy:2.cnHint: 引路人给了我一个数据芯片，警告我不会____里面的内容。
enjoy:2.hook: Someone had been watching me since day one.
enjoy:2.line: 'Trust me, you will not *enjoy* this — but look anyway.'

fact:2.en: Ali sent a single line over the dead channel: 'Check the broadcast log.' I did. Hidden in the static of Channel Seven was a *fact* no one was meant to find — the signal had not gone dark by accident. It had been silenced by a command sent from inside our own building.
fact:2.cnHint: 藏在静电杂音里的一个____揭示：信号中断并非意外。
fact:2.hook: The command carried a familiar access code — mine.
fact:2.line: 'The *fact* is, someone inside killed that signal on purpose.'

news:2.en: The morning *news* feed looked normal: weather, traffic, the usual noise. But Grey Crow had taught me to read the gaps. Between two traffic reports, a three-second silence carried a pulse — a coded message meant for someone in this city. I recorded it and ran it through the filter. The pulse spelled one word: 'Run.'
news:2.cnHint: 看似普通的早间____播报中，隐藏着一条编码警告信息。
news:2.hook: The message had been sent two minutes ago — from this building.
news:2.line: 'The *news* looks clean, but listen to the silence between words.'

company:2.en: Zero did not work alone — that much was clear now. Whoever had built the sub-basement room had the *company* of at least two others, judging by the three different handwriting styles on the notes. Three people. Three sets of eyes. I had been thinking of Zero as a single shadow. I was wrong.
company:2.cnHint: 地下室里的字迹证明零点并非孤身行动，他有____。
company:2.hook: One of the three handwriting styles looked uncomfortably like Ali's.
company:2.line: 'Zero had *company* — and one of them has been close to us.'

cost:2.en: Grey Crow looked at the broken transmitter on the table. 'Fixing this will *cost* more than credits,' he said quietly. 'It will cost time we do not have, and silence we cannot afford to break.' He was right. Every hour we spent here was an hour Zero used to move, shift, and vanish deeper into the city's signal noise.
cost:2.cnHint: 修复发射器的____不只是钱，还有我们根本没有的时间。
cost:2.hook: Outside, a new signal began broadcasting on Channel Seven.
cost:2.line: 'The real *cost* here is not money — it is time.'

idea:2.en: I stared at the wall of coded notes and felt nothing click. Then Ali's voice crackled over the earpiece: 'Flip the grid.' It was a strange *idea* — reading the code as a mirror image — but I tried it. The random marks rearranged into a clean address: a warehouse on the east pier, dark for three years.
idea:2.cnHint: 阿里提出了一个奇特的____，将密码镜像翻转后，地址清晰浮现。
idea:2.hook: The warehouse had been rented under my name.
idea:2.line: 'It sounds strange, but this *idea* just cracked the whole pattern.'

suggest:2.en: Deep inside the old signal tower, I found a folded paper tucked behind a broken panel. The symbols on it *suggest* a hidden broadcast — channel seven, midnight. Grey Crow had warned me about this place. Someone wanted me to find this note. But who left it, and why now?
suggest:2.cnHint: 信号塔里的纸条____着某个秘密频道的存在。
suggest:2.line: Grey Crow said, 'These marks *suggest* you were expected here.'

improve:2.en: Ali pulled up the signal map on her cracked screen. 'We need to *improve* the receiver or we lose channel seven forever,' she said, soldering wires in the dark. Sparks flew across the wet rooftop. Below us, Zero's crew was already moving through the street fog.
improve:2.cnHint: 阿栗努力____接收器的性能，以免失去关键频道。
improve:2.hook: Then the signal map went completely black.
improve:2.line: Ali said, 'If we *improve* the receiver now, we still have a chance.'

affect:2.en: The encoded broadcast from channel seven did not just carry words — it carried a low frequency that could *affect* the listener's memory. Grey Crow had told me this weeks ago, but I had not believed him. Now, standing in the archive basement, I could not remember my own name.
affect:2.cnHint: 七频道的信号会____听者的记忆。
affect:2.hook: Somewhere above me, a door slammed shut.
affect:2.line: Grey Crow warned, 'Do not listen too long — it will *affect* your mind.'

support:2.en: Hidden inside a cracked street lamp near the old port, I found a sealed chip. The data on it listed names — people who had given quiet *support* to the underground broadcast network for years. Grey Crow's name was not there. Zero's was, circled in red.
support:2.cnHint: 芯片里记录着多年来为地下广播网络提供____的人名。
support:2.line: Ali whispered, '*Support* for the network runs deeper than we ever knew.'

hand:2.en: The map was drawn by *hand* on the back of an old transit ticket, every line careful and deliberate. I found it folded inside a hollow wall near the channel seven relay point. Grey Crow's style — I had seen it before. He had been here recently. Very recently.
hand:2.cnHint: 一张____绘制的地图藏在中继站旁的墙壁里。
hand:2.hook: The ink was not yet dry.
hand:2.line: Ali said, 'Only Grey Crow draws a map by *hand* like this.'

finding:2.en: The *finding* stopped me cold: channel seven had been active for thirty years, not three. The old server logs in the flooded basement proved it. Someone had been broadcasting coded messages through every storm, every blackout, every city lockdown. This was not a new rebellion. It was a very old one.
finding:2.cnHint: 这一____让我震惊：七频道的历史远比我们以为的长得多。
finding:2.hook: And someone was still listening — right now.
finding:2.line: I told Ali, 'This *finding* changes everything we thought we knew.'

ago:2.en: Grey Crow slid a dusty data card across the table. 'This was recorded twenty years *ago*,' he said quietly. I pressed play. My own voice came out of the speaker — calm, certain, giving orders to the very network I was now hunting. I did not remember any of it.
ago:2.cnHint: 一张二十年____录制的数据卡里，藏着令我不安的秘密。
ago:2.hook: I had been here before, and forgotten everything.
ago:2.line: Grey Crow said, 'Twenty years *ago*, you built this yourself.'

essay:2.en: Tucked inside a library terminal on level nine, I found a short *essay* — no author, no date. It described channel seven not as a rebel tool but as a life-line for people the city had erased. Every sentence was precise, angry, and true. By the last line, my hands were shaking.
essay:2.cnHint: 一篇藏在图书馆终端里的____，揭示了七频道真正的意义。
essay:2.hook: The final sentence had my case number in it.
essay:2.line: Ali said, 'Whoever wrote this *essay* knew you were coming.'

conversation:2.en: I found the chip behind a loose tile in the Channel Seven relay room. It held a single recorded *conversation* — two voices, low and careful, trading a name I was not supposed to know. I played it twice. The second time, I noticed the silence at the end was not empty. It was waiting.
conversation:2.cnHint: 我在中继室的地砖后发现一枚芯片，里面存着一段____，涉及一个禁忌的名字。
conversation:2.hook: The silence at the end was shaped like a question.
conversation:2.line: Grey Crow said, 'That *conversation* was erased from every public record — so why does it still exist?'

self:2.en: The mirror in the abandoned Channel Seven booth showed my face, but the ID tag floating beside my reflection named someone else. I touched the glass. The tag flickered and reset to my real name. Somewhere between those two names was the *self* I had been before this job changed me.
self:2.cnHint: 废弃播报室的镜子里，浮现的身份标签让我开始怀疑自己的____。
self:2.hook: My real name felt less familiar than the fake one.
self:2.line: Ali whispered, 'Hold on to your *self* — Zero wants you to forget who you are.'

age:2.en: The data vault under Channel Seven had not been opened since the broadcast *age* of the 2040s, when open signals were still legal. Dust covered every shelf. Ali ran a finger along one case and held it up: the dust was grey, but underneath, the metal was still warm.
age:2.cnHint: 频道七地下数据库封存于某个____，但阿栗发现里面的金属至今仍有余温。
age:2.hook: Warm metal in a fifty-year-old vault means someone was just here.
age:2.line: Ali said, 'Nothing from that *age* should still be running — nothing.'

future:2.en: The encoded map on the wall of the relay room pointed not to a place but to a time — three days from now, marked in red. Grey Crow studied it without blinking. 'Someone planned this long before we arrived,' he said. The *future* had already been written, and we were just catching up.
future:2.cnHint: 中继室墙上的密图指向的不是地点，而是三天后的____。
future:2.hook: We were already three moves behind an unseen hand.
future:2.line: Grey Crow said quietly, 'The *future* on that map is not a guess — it is a schedule.'

effect:2.en: Ali triggered the old Channel Seven broadcast antenna by accident. The signal lasted four seconds. The *effect* spread fast: every screen within two blocks lit up with the same seven-digit code, then went dark. Passersby stopped, looked up, and quickly looked away, as if they had been trained to forget.
effect:2.cnHint: 阿栗意外触发天线，短暂信号产生的____令方圆两个街区的屏幕同时亮起同一串数字。
effect:2.hook: People looked away too fast — that kind of fast is learned.
effect:2.line: Ali said, 'I did not expect that *effect* — did you teach them to ignore it?'

local:2.en: The *local* repair shop on Tide Street had been closed for a year, yet its sign flickered on at exactly midnight. I pressed my ear to the door. Inside, someone was typing — steady, unhurried, as if they had all the time in the world and knew I was listening.
local:2.cnHint: 潮街上一家____的修理铺早已关门，但午夜时分，里面传来笃定的键盘声。
local:2.hook: Unhurried typing in a locked shop is its own kind of threat.
local:2.line: Zero's voice came through the wall: 'The *local* grid is mine — every node, every light.'

tend:2.en: Grey Crow warned me that Channel Seven signals *tend* to loop — the same fragment cycling until someone with the right key breaks the pattern. I listened for twenty minutes before I heard it: a half-second gap, always in the same place, like a door left open inside the noise.
tend:2.cnHint: 灰鸦提醒我，频道七的信号____会不断循环，直到有人用正确的密钥打断它。
tend:2.hook: A gap that repeats is not a flaw — it is an invitation.
tend:2.line: Grey Crow said, 'Signals like this *tend* to lead you exactly where someone wants you to go.'

term:2.en: The contract was burned into the wall in small white letters — seven lines, formal and cold. The final *term* read: 'Silence is consent.' I had been in this relay room for six minutes without transmitting a refusal. According to whoever wrote this, I had already agreed to something I had not yet read.
term:2.cnHint: 墙上刻着一份合约，最后一条____写道：沉默即同意——而我已经沉默了六分钟。
term:2.hook: Six minutes of silence had signed my name to something unknown.
term:2.line: Zero's text appeared below the last line: 'You missed the *term* that matters most.'

reduce:2.en: Deep inside Sub-Station 7, I found a humming black box wired to the city's broadcast grid. A counter on its screen ticked downward. Ali whispered, 'It will *reduce* the signal strength across all channels — silence every voice in Harbor City within minutes.' My hands moved before my mind caught up.
reduce:2.cnHint: 变电站深处，一个黑盒子正在把全城的广播信号____到零。
reduce:2.hook: The counter hit thirty seconds and kept falling.
reduce:2.line: 'This device will *reduce* every voice in the city to silence.'
